DOTA_Crownfall_EncounterDesc_FlappySkywr: Race against Batrider through a dangerous pass. You may be fast, but he won't play fair!
DOTA_Crownfall_FlappySkywrath_HowToPlay:
KEEP FLYING
Use your mouse and click to stay in the air. Hitting obstacles or the ground will slow you down, so keep on flapping those wings!
DOTA_VisualNovel_act2_Dialogue_batrider-: Batrider!
You!
What? What'd I do?
Not you, Red. Half-man over there.
State your business with me, gremlin.
Not YOU, baby, the other half-man.
You. Bird guy.
I am Dragonus — Skywrath Mage, and Captain of the Queensguard.
Ain't that somethin'! It can TALK!
Or is it just pretendin' to talk, Like a parrot? Who's a good Dragonus? Does Dragonus want a crack—
We have no time for this. As leader of this questing party, I—
What? Hold on, I thought I was the leader.
Yes. I also thought Axe was leading this party.
Regardless, we have urgent business elsewhere.
More urgent than a WAGER?
Yes. FAR more urgent than a—
Hold on, I wanna hear about this.
A Wager!
So what's all this about a wager?
Well, my bat ate some kind of weird volcano plant and, I'll be honest...
I don't think he's going to make it.
I am sorry for your impending loss, but, unfortunately, we are not a roving band of veterinarians.
So what's the wager part?
It's like this, baby. I'm gonna need a new ride, and there ain't no more morde-bats in this stinkin' desert.
But we do not have any morde-bats either.
You got somethin' better: the bird guy! Let's do a race! If I win, he has to let me ride him wherever I want.
A Race!
So whattaya say? We race. If I win, I own Dragonus.
That seems fair.
Absolutely not. This is insane.
Yeah, it sure is crazy. Just out of curiosity, though, what do WE get if Dragonus wins?
He can have my bat.
COUGH
Interesting...
We do not want a giant sick bat. Goodbye.
Pride and Prizes!
Wait, wait. Hold on. If you won't race for prizes, then do it for pride.
Dragonus? Chickenus, more like it. Captain of the... Hen... house.
Dragonus! This is very serious. He has accused you of cowardice. Now you MUST race.
We don't have time for this!
Look, I ain't askin' you to race around the planet. Just... to that butte over there. It'll take three minutes.
Ya filthy coward.
Dragonus! He called you out AGAIN! He keeps doing it! He's not gonna stop!
I am starting to think you ARE a coward.
Fine. FINE.
Flap!
Well, you beat me fair and square, baby. Like I said, you get to fly away with your dignity.
Yes, fine.
And this bat.
WET COUGH
We will not be taking your bat.
Now that is a shame. This sick bat's gonna be ridin' ME in a few hours.
Well, I guess if you ain't gonna take him, I'll just have to put him down right now.
*Sigh* Fine. We will take the bat.
GREEN SNEEZE
DOTA_VisualNovel_act2_Dialogue_flappy-sk: I don't believe it! You BEAT me!
Nice flyin', pal. You won fair and square.
Sorry, bird guy. That's second place.
Nice flappin'. But not nice enough.
